Subject: AuroraEdge — post-discovery: pick 30-min intro (3 windows + attendees)

Hi Alison —

Thanks again for a productive chat today. Quick recap: you’ve got a clear need to reduce inference latency for your multitenant search pipeline and a hard requirement around query-level audit logs for compliance. We covered how Redwood’s hosted API + optional private deployment maps to those priorities.

Next step: brief 30-minute intro demo focused on low-latency inference patterns and the audit/logging workflow. Can you confirm who from your side should join? Based on what you said, it sounds like:
- Engineering/Infra (to validate ops/latency)
- Security or Compliance (audit/log requirements)
- Procurement (to cover contracting timeline)

I’m proposing three 30-min windows next week — please pick the one that works best for the core team, or tell me constraints and I’ll book:
A) Tue Nov 2, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
B) Wed Nov 3, 1:00–1:30 PM PT
C) Thu Nov 4, 3:30–4:00 PM PT

Agenda (30m):
- 0–5m: quick intros & success criteria
- 5–20m: product walkthrough (latency demo + KV/prefix caching example)
- 20–25m: security/compliance callouts (audit logs, retention)
- 25–30m: next steps / mutual action plan

I attached a short post-call recap and a draft mutual action plan to seed the procurement conversation (see attachments). If you prefer a different week or want a concurrent technical deep-dive with your infra lead, we can make the demo slightly longer and include a separate Q&A slot.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0128
